pcs.pc_description: check the compressor discharge and suction pressures after starting the refrigeration system to ensure they are in the normal operating range
check for proper refrigerant charge
monitor and maintain the required compressor oil level
check the voltage and amperage at the compressor terminals
check the piping and electrical connections for vibration and take the necessary corrective measures
check fans on the evaporator coil and condensing unit of the air-cooled condenser to ensure they are operational and turning in the correct direction
check the cooling tower of the water-cooled condenser to ensure there is no refrigerant leakage
set the defrost control/ timer clock to the required duration and verify the defrost initiation settings
set the temperature control to the desired temperature range
check the functioning and performance of sensors and temperature measuring device

modules.module_title: Store food products in the cold storage room

pcs.pc_description: determine the work requirements
check the operation of the cooling equipment to ensure the readiness of the cold storage facility for use
calibrate the temperature and humidity measuring instruments of the storage facility
check the quality of the product to be stored in the cold storage facility based on the relevant physical parameter
check the product packaging to ensure it is intact
set the appropriate storage room/chamber parameters, such as temperature and humidity required to store different types of food products as per the storage parameter chart
check readings to ensure the set storage parameters and make the necessary adjustments or set controls in the PLC and monitor system for the computerized cold storage units
check the weight and temperature of the food products
store the food products in cold storage using the appropriate tools and equipment
check and ensure optimum air circulation between the cartons/ packages in the cold storage
maintain the storage room parameters during the entire storage period, checking and adjusting the temperature and humidity, as required
check the temperature of air and stored food periodically to ensure conformance to the applicable specifications and standards
examine the storage products periodically for decay, mold growth, sprouting, shrivelling, etc
maintain the products in cold storage for the recommended duration
check the temperature, weight, and quality of the food products retrieved from the cold storage
identify and segregate the agricultural produce with shrivelling, freezer burns, mould growth, deterioration, etc
report any issues, such as equipment malfunction to the supervisor and take the suggested corrective action

modules.module_title: Inspect, repair/replace the refrigeration system and components

pcs.pc_description: conduct periodic inspections of the refrigeration system and components for correct operation
check the operating conditions and identify the need for repair or adjustment
detect refrigerant leaks following the appropriate methods and take appropriate corrective action, including recovering and recharging the refrigerant
identify the malfunctioning of components following the appropriate fault detection methods
repair or replace the faulty components following the equipment manufacturer’s guidelines
test for the correct operation of equipment after reassembling following repair
charge the system with the correct refrigerant, as required
maintain the required operating conditions in the cold storage for the efficient operation of the refrigeration equipment

modules.module_title: Maintain the refrigeration system and components

pcs.pc_description: carry out periodic maintenance of the refrigeration system as per the manufacturer’s guidelines
check the evaporators for ice accumulation/proper defrosting and wash the evaporator coils to remove dust and foreign materials drawn into the fins
check the evaporator and condenser fan blades for fractures
carry out maintenance of the fan, including cleaning, tightening of fan screws, lubrication, and replacing worn-out fan blades and faulty fan motor
check for the correct operation of defrost controls and the correct position of defrost heaters to ensure optimum heat transfer to the evaporator coil
check the voltage at each heater terminal and ensure heater terminals are in good condition
identify and remove foreign materials from the drain pan to ensure proper drainage and prevent blockages and consequent water overflow or ice buildup
check the drain line heater to ensure that it functions correctly and prevents ice buildup, potential blockages and consequent system failures
replace the worn-out condenser motor in the compressor unit
check the electrical components and tighten all electrical connections
identify and replace the damaged wiring
check and ensure proper functioning of pressure and safety controls, solenoid valves, and cold room temperature thermostat
check and maintain the recommended oil level in the compressor unit
clean the condenser at appropriate intervals as per the manufacturer’s guidelines
check the condition of refrigerant line insulation and replace it, as necessary
check the refrigerant level to ensure it is as recommended
check for refrigerant leakages and take appropriate action to plug leakages, as required
maintain the daily inventory records, including, product description, batch number, Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), quantity, weight and storage location
update the daily cold storage stock records, accounting for the receipt, dispatch and handling of food products
track the expiration or best-before dates of perishable items and follow the FIFO technique to maintain the stock quality
maintain the temperature records, including monitoring logs, temperature readings and deviations
carry out appropriate documentation concerning the scheduled and completed maintenance activities for refrigeration
maintain records of safety inspections, internal audits, quality checks and any issues identified and resolved, in compliance with the applicable regulations
